hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Curve steepening plus an official contract open interest expansion is an oi shock into a richer storage curve, not OI-rising-implies-buy and not slope-as-level. Not price momentum.

hypotheses.name: STEEPEN_OI_EXPAND
hypotheses.target: next-session front open-to-open after OI knowledge_time
hypotheses.validation: pre-registered; leakage; knowledge-time; determinism; lineage; FDR q=0.05; four Xavier

hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Curve steepening reversed (flattening) plus contract open interest expansion is an oi shock into a tighter curve. Joint curve move plus oi shock, not a curve level. Not price momentum.

hypotheses.hypothesis: When the official curve flattens and official front open interest expands, tightness is rising with new participation. After OI knowledge, next-session front return is positive.
hypotheses.name: FLATTEN_OI_EXPAND
hypotheses.validation: same gates; not a z score search
